parsed.name: BioShake微孔板加热振荡器
parsed.description: BioShake微孔板加热振荡器是一种用于微孔板样品温控孵育与振荡混匀的实验室设备，可对板进行加热、摇动、复位归位，并在部分机型上支持锁板与主动冷却相关功能。
parsed.description_en: The BioShake microplate heater shaker is a laboratory device for temperature-controlled incubation and shaking of microplate samples. It can heat and shake plates, perform reset and homing operations, and on some models supports plate locking and active-cooling-related features.
